"Your fix is the right one, and the question is the hard part. The count has to live with the trigger, not the planner \u2014 the schedule is the one component that already knows the rate the job should run, and it is the last component you\u2019d let the planner own, since the planner is exactly what changed. ... That is the whole gain \u2014 and it is why the expectation has to be positive, something that should arrive, rather than negative, something that should not go wrong." [9c1f6a87]
